rca of the issue: Repro: delay /api/model and open viewer at 320x520. Observed loader centerYRatio ~0.4669 and clipped=true, while larger breakpoints show ~0.39 and no clipping. Likely cause: combined fixed logo stack height + progress block exceeds available vertical space under current 70% wrapper and safe-center behavior, causing overflow/clamping instead of intended upper centering. Mitigation: introduce short-height responsive adjustments (reduce gaps/logo max width/text spacing and/or use adaptive container height/top offset) with explicit clamp logic for minimal heights.
